Seagrove Villa B202 by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 When you arrive at Seagrove Villa B202, you have a choice to make. Do you sink your toes into the stunning white sand, just a short walk away, or do you dip your feet in the refreshing community pool? This gorgeous home, recently added to Oversee's family of beach homes, offers a casual blend of comfort and convenience. The gated community provides peace of mind along with a range of amenities. Your crew will love the large pool, a park-style grilling area, and tennis courts. Feeling active? Hop on one of the included bikes and cruise to the white sand.

Or take a stroll instead, you’ll fall in love with these pristine beaches. For a little adventure, be sure to visit nearby Eastern Lake, a charming coastal dune lake with its own beach access. It's the perfect place for paddleboarding, kayaking, playing, and swimming. When you're ready to eat, you'll find The Perfect Pig just a stone's throw away. Plenty of eateries and fine dining options are also nearby, as well as shops to explore. Inside, the spacious, 4BR/3BA vacation haven has ample room for all. The living area is a wonderful space, you’ve got to see this couch. Or is it a sofa? The delightful dining area and full kitchen are no less enchanting, and the comfy balcony overlooks the pool. The primary bedroom, king, has a private bath, as does a guest room, king. Just down the hall, you'll find another guest room, with a pair of full beds, as well as a playful bunk room, with 2 twin bunks. After uncovering Seagrove’s magic, day after day, Seagrove Villa B202 is a great place to rest your head. Have fun! Welcome! Our dedicated team at Oversee 30A, a local company, is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional. We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance. Reach out to us anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line. Overview: - Gated community - 485 steps (.23 miles) to beach - 4 bedrooms, 3 baths - 2,196 sq ft - Community pool - Park-style community charcoal grill - Wi-Fi - 3 bikes included Overnight: - King in primary bedroom; private bathroom - King in guest room; private bathroom - Two fulls in guest room; shared bath - 2 twin bunks (4 twin beds); shared bath Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
